Questions.question: Why does the instructor check the footing position with markings?
Questions.answer: Because the footing must be in the correct position.
options: Because correct positioning helps the foot.
Because the footing must be in the correct position.
Because footing must be excavated.

Questions.question: Why does the instructor measure the excavation depth with a tape?
Questions.answer: To ensure the strength of the structure.
options: To ensure the strength of the concrete.
To ensure the strength of the structure.
To ensure the depth is incorrect.

Questions.question: Why does the instructor pour concrete into the footing trench carefully?
Questions.answer: To ensure the concrete fills all corners properly.
options: To ensure all the corners dry faster.
To ensure the concrete fills all corners properly.
To reduce the amount of concrete used.

Questions.question: Why does the instructor keep the concrete surface moist during curing?
Questions.answer: To help the concrete gain strength.
options: To make the concrete dry faster.
To help the concrete gain strength.
To cure the moisture.

Questions.question: Why does the instructor stress careful preparation before block laying?
Questions.answer: Because early mistakes cause problems later.
options: Because heavy blocks cause problems later.
Because early mistakes cause problems later.
Because mortar sets very slowly and causes problems later.

activity_c.text: Today, I want to explain two routine processes that we practise in the Construction Technology section.
First, I will explain how we prepare and cast a concrete footing.
After that, we will move on to a basic block-laying preparation process.
First, let’s look at the concrete footing process.
Before any concrete work starts, we check the footing position with markings on the ground.
Next, we measure the excavation depth with a tape.
We mix cement, sand, and aggregate to ratio using the correct proportions.
Once the mix is ready, we pour concrete into the footing trench carefully.
Then, we level the top surface with a straight edge.
Finally, we keep the concrete surface moist during curing.
Now, let’s move on to the block-laying preparation process.
Before continuing, we check the level and alignment again.
